suggestions.reasoning: As a Front-end developer, you already possess the logic-building skills necessary for API integration. The transition to AI Workflow Architect leverages your ability to 'glue' systems together, a critical need in the Vietnamese market where businesses are moving from manual BPO tasks to AI-augmented operations.
suggestions.whyItFitsYou: Your strength in self-directed learning and your background in React/TypeScript provide a perfect foundation for building AI-integrated interfaces. You are already comfortable with the 'logic' of web applications; now you will simply shift from building UI components to building AI-driven data pipelines.
